scope: Complete controlled implementation acceptance for the one-game guided calibration workflow

criteria.statement: A Steam game can enter a bounded guided workflow from one target selector without low-level case flags.

tests.proves: One selector performs confirmed registration and Steam client setup before continuing under the durable target identity.
One guided invocation executes the bounded useful case sequence without manual phase or protocol composition.

criteria.statement: Direct, Steam, and declared publisher targets receive the same inferred guided handoff where ownership rules support them.

tests.proves: The Windows command infers all three supported topologies, applies conservative defaults, and emits durable handoff guidance.
Publisher topology retains its declared launcher-to-client role order.

criteria.statement: Ambiguous games, Steam metadata, and supported stored client declarations require a stable explicit choice and are never guessed.

tests.proves: A content-derived identifier narrows ambiguous installed-game discovery before registration.
A content-derived identifier narrows ambiguous Steam client metadata before authoring.
A content-derived identifier narrows an ambiguous non-Steam stored client declaration before a confirmed conditional rewrite.

criteria.statement: Defaults come from current target and process authority while exact advanced dimensions remain inspectable and immutable.

tests.proves: Conservative routing and family defaults and an explicit IPv6 override flow into every exact case.
Advanced case intent remains visible and immutable across process resume.

criteria.statement: Reachability must become a current positive fact before any trust-bearing attempt is offered.

tests.proves: The guided sequence orders reachability before every observed protocol attempt.
A reachability phase rejects trust-bearing configuration before mutation.
TLS refuses before mutation without current reachability for the same exact case.

criteria.statement: Every guided effect exposes exact target, launch, routing, deadline, evidence, trust, and cleanup authority before confirmation.

tests.proves: The guided front door emits and separately confirms complete plan-bound authority for each attempt.
Controlled reachability and TLS plans carry exact deadlines, routing, family, backend, trust, and fact dimensions.

criteria.statement: Warm targets receive bounded operator-owned normal-shutdown guidance and fragcap never closes or kills them.

tests.proves: The Windows guided command starts no session for a warm target until explicit retry and reports process_control=none.
A partial operator shutdown never becomes cold authority.

criteria.statement: Login, update, EULA, anti-cheat, no-traffic, and gameplay work remain distinct operator action or incomplete states.

tests.proves: Every explicit operator action is stored and resumed without entering the session executor.
Partial or no-positive-evidence outcomes remain incomplete instead of becoming generic success.

criteria.statement: Compatibility facts remain exact and append-only, retaining history, negative, stale, partial, and conflicting observations.

tests.proves: Retests append conflicting observations without replacing prior history.
The public matrix preserves repeated and conflicting exact stored rows.
Every non-positive routing state retains its exact proposal reason.

criteria.statement: Successful completion reconciles concise coverage and emits a paste-ready ordinary Deep Capture command.

tests.proves: Completed controlled work reconciles requested, observed, completed, and remaining coverage before handoff.
Ready guidance emits an exact store-bound ordinary Deep Capture command without a session effect.

criteria.statement: A rerun proposes only missing, stale, negative, conflicting, legacy, mismatched, or explicitly requested work and names the reason.

tests.proves: Every non-current evidence class receives a distinct stable retest reason.
Resume freshly suppresses completed exact work and starts no redundant attempt.
An explicitly requested current protocol is reported without inventing another measurement.

criteria.statement: Human and JSON modes expose one stable durable workflow suitable for interruption and exact resume.

tests.proves: Human and structured projections retain the same workflow authority without corrupting JSON output.
A crash-shaped checkpoint first becomes a durable no-effect interruption.
A later process resumes with fresh authority and a durable non-reused attempt destination.

criteria.statement: Controlled and ordinary Windows CI evidence covers every required topology and terminal state without a real game or trust mutation.

tests.proves: The ordinary Windows suite covers all supported launch topologies and successful handoff.
The ordinary Windows suite covers warm-state refusal and bounded retry.
Controlled orchestration covers interruption after prior progress.
A controlled trust failure retains exact cleanup.
Controlled cleanup failure cannot skip remaining cleanup or terminal evidence.
Steam topology is inferred and handed off in the ordinary Windows suite.
Direct topology is inferred and handed off in the ordinary Windows suite.
Publisher topology is inferred and handed off in the ordinary Windows suite.
Warm state remains effect-free until explicit operator retry.
A stored launch ambiguity requires an exact content-derived choice.
Partial evidence cannot claim completion.
Trust-bearing work refuses before mutation without exact reachability.
Interruption retains exact durable continuation.
Cleanup attempts every owned resource and preserves terminal evidence.
Successful controlled completion emits exact ordinary Deep Capture handoff.
